name: Level_1 - Task_10
description: Run the initial 300 K stage of the aluminum heat-capacity study. Build a periodic 108-atom crystal by repeating a conventional cubic FCC cell with lattice parameter 4.05 Å by 3 x 3 x 3. Use the supplied MACE-MP-0 checkpoint and keep the cell fixed. Initialize velocities at 300 K once with a recorded random seed. Choose a suitable thermostat, integration settings, equilibration time, production time, and sampling. Save a restartable final state so a later heating sequence can continue without resetting positions or momenta. Report the mean total energy per atom and the overall and directional kinetic temperatures. Save the initial state, thermal trace, production trajectory, settings, and scripts needed to check the result and continuity.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in only the parts needed for this task. Leave the Level 2 parts empty. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
